name: RCM Technologies, Inc.
business_overview: RCM Technologies, Inc. engages in the provision of business and technology solutions in the United States, Canada, Puerto Rico, Europe, and Philippines. The company operates through three segments: Engineering; Specialty Health Care; and Life Sciences, Data and Solutions (LS&D). It offers engineering services, including project management engineering, integrated design engineering, transmission and distribution power delivery, engineering analysis, engineering-procurement-construction, configuration management, hardware/software validation and verification, quality assurance, technical writing and publications, manufacturing process planning and improvement, and 3D/BIM integrated design. The company also provides long-term and short-term staffing, executive search, international recruitment, and placement solutions in the fields of allied and therapy staffing, correctional healthcare staffing, health information management, nursing services, physician and advanced practice, school staffing and recruitment, and telepractice. In addition, it offers enterprise business solutions, application development and support, IT infrastructure deployment and management, data solutions, digitization, human capital management solutions, as well as technology and business solutions for the life sciences industry and other specific verticals. The company serves aerospace/defense, educational institutions, energy, financial services, healthcare, life sciences, manufacturing and distribution, public sector, and technology. RCM Technologies, Inc. was incorporated in 1971 and is based in Pennsauken, New Jersey.

classification_meta.logic_summary: Provides business and technology solutions including engineering, healthcare staffing, and IT services on a contract basis.

narrative.text:
**Business & market dynamics:** The business mix is pivoting toward specialty healthcare while engineering revenues soften, though a robust energy backlog points to future infrastructure-driven demand. Secular tailwinds in K-12 and modern infrastructure support the growth narrative. Near-term results missed earnings expectations, yet the stock advanced as the market focused on operational resilience and the visibility provided by the backlog rather than the shortfall.

**Management strategy and execution:** Management preserved analyst confidence by highlighting the energy backlog and resilient operations, driving a share-price gain even after an earnings miss. The deliberate shift toward higher-growth healthcare and infrastructure services signals active portfolio repositioning, but weak operating cash flow and strained debt coverage cast doubt on financial execution. Credibility now depends on converting backlog into stronger, sustained cash generation.

RCM Technologies reported relatively stable results for the thirteen weeks ended April 4, 2026, with revenue of $83.0 million versus $84.5 million a year earlier. Net income was $3.8 million, down slightly from $4.2 million, and diluted earnings per share were $0.52 compared with $0.54.

Business mix shifted meaningfully. Specialty Healthcare revenue rose to $48.1 million, while Engineering declined to $26.1 million and Life Sciences, Data and Solutions eased to $8.8 million. Gross margin improved modestly to 26.5%, but higher selling, general and administrative expenses kept operating income at $5.9 million versus $6.6 million.
